timing: Accelerated 2000 actions ×300 active model-ms =600000ms per game. Complete campaign. Wall cost is shared-workspace execution, not a browser performance benchmark.

definitions.progress: 36 minus minimum directed opposite-edge coordinate gap among home-supplied own stones; sampled each completed round. Higher is better.
definitions.routeDeficit: Minimum non-owned adjacency cells between any home-supplied own stone and opposite edge. Excludes enemy anchors; ignores terrain/action costs and alliances. Existing own bridge reach is included through the supplied starting set. Sampled every30actions.
definitions.airportLocal: Action target within4 of any public airport. Local non-advancing counts non-air own construction/engineering actions without immediate supplied-frontier or adjacency-deficit improvement; defensive value remains possible, so this alone does not prove waste.
definitions.spatial: center radius0–6; transition7–11; flank12–18. Combat counts capture/destroy event cell incidences, including automatic fire. Densities divide by actual region cell count; occupation also divides by samples.
definitions.holding: Credited complete-round holds, reconstructed at scoring boundaries; first connections and repeated arrivals are separately counted.
definitions.planner: Intent episodes group the same actor/type/target/commit ply. Strategy labels, reuse, and reported completions are diagnostic; frontier, supplied target, air execution, and goal arrival are observed separately. Whole-action resolution can include upkeep and following-player automatic fire.
definitions.airportFollowup: Activation episodes end on loss; first air use must originate at that exact airport before loss. Time-to-use is ply difference divided by6, expressed as approximate owner actions.
definitions.limitation: Planner candidate compared with release96c109a. Verify rules and seeded layouts remain equal in fixtures. The six seeds with rotated seats and balanced first-profile margins are repeated configurations, not independent seed samples. Planner strategy labels are diagnostics; execution and public board effects are measured separately.
